description: This file defines an interface for text elements in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifying methods for getting and setting text, retrieving font information, and obtaining a hash code.

classes.name: ITextElement
classes.description: Interface that defines methods for text elements within RichText in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the element.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the element and returns the interface instance.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the font object associated with the text element, or null if not set.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the text element for comparison or identification.
